title: A check refuses a waiting-page post whose home decision or ruling was not read in the same turn
why: Two owner items (784, 787) were posted for questions that decisions notes-merge-union and claude-md-change-is-flagged already rule. Incident 3 (00:37 CST Nov 14, triage): item 822 (child repos' lane lint unknown) was posted although ruling own-lint-skip-green-rollup-a (owner 21:01 CST Nov 13) already settled it; the coordinator caught it. Triage's check searched the flag's words (lint-unknown-ok, touched job) and found a ruling about a nearby act but not this one, because the ruling is worded "skip the lane lint ... rollup is green". The check must search the question's topic words in rulings, steps and decisions (lane lint, skip, rollup), and the poster lists what it searched. Incident 4, 01:52 CST Nov 14 (triage, CORRECTED): posted page item 824 (pick-lane-hands-in-ready) after searching roadmap/rulings and steps only; the decision draft-until-reviewed (Q2, owner 09:44 CST Nov 12: a lane moves its PR to ready once after its last review and lane lint; target until the per-lane cutover) was not searched or cited, and the consultant and the coordinator both withdrew the question on that cite at 01:46. The coordinator took the withdrawal back at 01:47: the later owner word, the standing grant "Lane draft PR" (owner 17:19 CST Nov 12), says a lane never marks ready, so the two owner words clash and the question is real. Item 824 was closed 01:48 CST and reopened 01:50 CST, now citing both words. So the miss was a missing cite (the item did not name Q2), not a false question. The check must search docs/decisions on main as well as the rulings, and the post must cite every owner word it finds, earlier or later. Same family as incident 3 (item 822).
source: Triage's own misses 18:40 and 19:15 CST Nov 13, found by the consultant and the red-main lane.
